name: _host.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  media-figure/_host.scss — host-element contracts — :host display/size, :host-context class fallbacks for internal-main-item/internal-extra-item, and the zoom-to-fill ztf-video sizing.
//  Imported by media-figure.scss (manifest) — applies INSIDE the
//  <media-figure> shadow root; not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Shadow host ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

@supports selector(:host-context(*)) {
  :host-context(.internal-extra-item) {
    width: auto;
  }
}

// In carousel slide context: let host shrink to content width (the placeholder drives it)
:host(.internal-extra-item),
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item']) {
  width: auto;
}

:host(.internal-main-item),
:host([classes*='internal-main-item']) {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;

  figure {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 70vh;
    max-height: 70dvh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
    -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
    -webkit-mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(var(--color-white-raw), var(--black));
    mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(var(--color-white-raw), var(--black));
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);

    @include layout-1024() {
      -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    }
  }

  .render-placeholder {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    height: auto;
    // On mobile: stretch full width — but never past the file's own
    // width (--mf-natural-w): the cover may be *smaller* than the
    // section, never larger than its source.
    width: 100%;
    max-width: min(100%, var(--mf-natural-w));

    @include layout-768() {
      // At tablet+: use natural SVG dimensions, cap at container — and
      // clamp both axes at the file's intrinsic size.
      width: auto;
      max-width: min(100%, var(--mf-natural-w));
      max-height: min(70vh, var(--mf-natural-h));
      max-height: min(70dvh, var(--mf-natural-h));
    }
  }

  .render-media,
  video.render-media {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    // Cover section is always full-bleed: fill and crop anchored to top center.
    // The box itself is already clamped at the file's intrinsic size on the
    // placeholder above, so cover can never paint the media past its source.
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: top center;
    -webkit-border-radius: inherit;
    border-radius: inherit;
  }
}

// ── Zoom-to-fill cover media ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// When ztf-video is set alongside internal-main-item, the video is intentionally
// full-bleed: it fills the frame and crops to top-center (e.g. hero backgrounds).
// This overrides the contain default set in the :host(.internal-main-item) block.
:host(.ztf-video.internal-main-item),
:host([classes*='ztf-video'][classes*='internal-main-item']),
:host(.ztf-video),
:host([classes*='ztf-video']) {
  .render-placeholder {
    // Fill full width in ztf mode so the container spans the section
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;

    @include layout-768() {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: 70vh;
      max-height: 70dvh;
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      // Ultra-wide bleed cap: without it, width:100% on a 5K viewport
      // makes the 70vh height clamp crop the video to a panoramic sliver
      // (≈5:1 displayed aspect). 175dvh keeps ≈2.5:1 — still full-bleed
      // cinematic, but the top-anchored crop stays readable.
      max-width: 175vh;
      max-width: 175dvh;
    }
  }

  figure {
    // The placeholder caps the bleed, but the media layers absolutely
    // fill the *figure* — it must carry the same cap or the crop remains.
    @include layout-2560() {
      max-width: 175vh;
      max-width: 175dvh;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }
  }

  .render-media,
  video.render-media {
    // Zoom-to-fill: fill frame and crop anchored to top center
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: top center;
  }
}
